PublicWarmPoolConfig.description_en: The warm pool configuration or request parameters
PublicWarmPoolConfig.description_zh: 预热池配置或请求参数

capacityPolicy.description_en: The warm pool capacity policy, which includes the base target capacity and optional scheduling rules
capacityPolicy.description_zh: 预热池容量策略，包含基础目标容量和可选的定时规则

deleting.description_en: Indicates whether the warm pool is being deleted
deleting.description_zh: 预热池是否处于删除过程中

templateID.description_en: The template ID, which specifies the template associated with the warm pool
templateID.description_zh: 模板 ID，指定预热池关联的模板

minReadySandboxes.description_en: The base target number of ready sandboxes. This parameter is required and can be set to 0
minReadySandboxes.description_zh: 基础目标就绪沙箱数量，必须提供，允许为 0

scheduledPolicies.description_en: The list of scheduled capacity rules. This parameter is optional
scheduledPolicies.description_zh: 定时容量规则列表，可省略

WarmPoolScheduledPolicy.description_en: The scheduled capacity rule for the warm pool

endTime.description_en: The end time when the rule expires, in RFC 3339 format
endTime.description_zh: 规则生效结束时间，使用 RFC 3339 格式

name.description_en: The name of the scheduled rule. It must be unique within the same warm pool
name.description_zh: 定时规则名称，同一预热池内须唯一

scheduleExpression.description_en: The cron expression for the scheduled rule, in the cron (second minute hour day month week) format
scheduleExpression.description_zh: 定时规则的 Cron 表达式，采用 cron(秒 分 时 日 月 周) 格式

startTime.description_en: The start time when the rule takes effect, in RFC 3339 format
startTime.description_zh: 规则生效起始时间，使用 RFC 3339 格式

target.description_en: The target number of ready sandboxes after the rule is triggered. The value can be 0
target.description_zh: 规则触发后的目标就绪沙箱数量，允许为 0

timeZone.description_en: The IANA time zone used to execute the scheduled rule
timeZone.description_zh: 执行定时规则所用的 IANA 时区
